notablePrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Kamahl's Will by paying {3}{G}, causing Arixmethes if it's a land and Minamo to become 1/1 Elementals with haste until end of turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.
